Class LoginSuccesfulEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.ServerEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.LoginSuccesfulEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LoginSuccesfulEvent extends ServerEvent
Event representing a successful login by a player. Inherits from ServerEvent. It contains the nickname of the player that successfully connected to the server.
